errors.evidence: The description states that the highest bar (for 2013) reaches approximately 1470 million BGN. However, the bar clearly extends above the 1500 line, reaching a value of approximately 1530 million BGN.
The description incorrectly identifies the bar for 2020 as the lowest. Visually, the bar for 2019 is the shortest.
The description states the value for the 2020 bar is around 610 million BGN. However, the bar for 2020 clearly ends below the 600 line, at a value of approximately 410 million BGN.
